preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100 and 2 <= m <= 100 for n, m in zip(n_values, m_values))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the dimensions n and m are between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in table)
preconditions.description: Each row in the table has a length equal to m.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in '01' for row in table for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the table contains either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of operations k is between 0 and the total number of cells in the table.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m and 1 <= x3 <= n and 1 <= y3 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations)
postconditions.description: All coordinates in the operations are within the bounds of the table.

postconditions.expression: all((x1, y1) != (x2, y2) and (x1, y1) != (x3, y3) and (x2, y2) != (x3, y3) for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations)
postconditions.description: All three cells in each operation are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(x1 - x2) <= 1 and abs(y1 - y2) <= 1 and abs(x1 - x3) <= 1 and abs(y1 - y3) <= 1 and abs(x2 - x3) <= 1 and abs(y2 - y3) <= 1 for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations)
postconditions.description: All three cells in each operation belong to a 2x2 square.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell == '0' for cell in row) for row in modified_table)
postconditions.description: After performing all operations, all cells in the table are '0'.
